_what: The error count this branch is allowed to carry. tools/validate_cards.py reports 613 errors today; making that BLOCKING would paint every branch red permanently, and a permanently red CI is how this repo learned to ignore CI. So the gate is a RATCHET instead: the backlog may shrink, never grow. The ratchet reads its pass mark from the BASE branch, never from the branch it is judging, and refuses to compare a run that saw less than this one did.
_how_to_update: When the count goes DOWN, run `python3 tools/validate_cards.py --quiet --json /tmp/r.json` and commit the new number here in the same PR that lowered it. Never raise it to make a red build green — that is the grandfathering this validator exists to refuse.
_why: kredme-data is PUBLIC and KredMe-main is PRIVATE, so CI here can never check the app out. This baseline is therefore measured the way CI measures it: against the vendored tools/app_mirror/ category list. With a real app checkout the count is the same 610 — the mirror is current — but the run is DEGRADED either way and says so.
_why_this_number_rose: IT ROSE, DELIBERATELY: 559 -> 604. This is the first branch to raise this number and it is not a regression being waved through. The founder instructed on 7-Sep: 'I WANT ALL SIDDHANT'S data in dev kredme-data. NO MISS. i will manually check.' Every earlier batch deliberately withheld reward rules, conditional exclusions and anything the engine cannot model; this branch loads all 48 documents in full. Where the rise comes from: L6.EXCLUSION_TYPE_INERT 188->205; L8.QUOTE_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_RATE 0->12; L6.UPI_RULE_SWALLOWS_BASE_RATE 3->9; L6.CATEGORY_BONUS_DROPPED 1->7; L4.POINT_VALUE_VS_REDEMPTION 5->8; L8.SOURCE_URL_NOT_A_URL 6->9; L6.RULE_FIRES_WIDER_THAN_ITS_EVIDENCE 19->21; L1.CONDITIONS_JSON_AS_TEXT 0->2. The largest class, L6.EXCLUSION_TYPE_INERT, is the direct arithmetic of 'no miss' - an exclusion the engine cannot read is now written as an inert 'other'/'txn_type' row so the fact is in the file, where before it was dropped and counted as nothing. L8.CONFIDENCE_HIGH_UNSOURCED and L8.QUOTE_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_RATE are provenance debt on rows sourced from a validator pack rather than an issuer URL. L6.UPI_RULE_SWALLOWS_BASE_RATE and L6.RULE_FIRES_WIDER_THAN_ITS_EVIDENCE are genuine ranking risks created by loading conditional rates the engine cannot gate, and they are listed card by card in the pull request for manual checking. Six codes went DOWN. No rule_name was renamed or deleted: zero lost against origin/dev.
